name: shop/place-and-verify
description: Click Place Order, then assert status=found. The multi-svc variant's OrderCoordinator /verify/:id proxies to PaymentService's /verify/:id — so a 404 means the charge never landed (Order returned 200 to the customer but Payment's DDB write didn't go through, or Order swallowed Payment's error). This is the journey-level catch for the multi-service-cascade pattern (#119 Gap 2) — POST /orders alone shows symptom but verify-via-Payment confirms the customer-facing invariant.
